create_CustomRoutingRouter: create a CustomRoutingRouter instance with a custom routing function for MoE layer routing
build_routing_method_type: build the routing method type property to identify Llama4 or Custom routing strategies
run_compute_routing: run compute routing to calculate top-k expert weights and IDs from hidden states and router logits

review_compute_routing: review compute_routing method that delegates to a custom routing function and returns topk weights and ids
